Product image registration/update

API for registering or updating product images.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/product_image_register.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code
(Shoplinker registration code)		 Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required partner_product_id string Your own product code
3. Required image_type string Image method Allowed values
  1. - URL method : URL
  2. - File method : FILE

URL method

    - Image url
A web-accessible path
ex) http://image.shoplinker.co.kr/images/banner/bn_admin_150210_3.jpg

FILE method

    - Image file format^^image content
Image file format, such as jpg or png
Image content (base_64 encode)
ex) jpg^^/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAAAQABAAD//gA8Q1JFQVRPUjogZ2QtanBlZyB2MS4wICh1c2luZyBJSkcgSlBFRyB2NjIpL

Default : URL
image_info
4. Required image_kind string Image type Allowed values
  1. - Main image : IMG1
  2. - Auction & Gmarket : IMG2
  3. - Coupang and others : IMG3
  4. - 11st listing image : IMG4
  5. - General marketplaces/home shopping : IMG5
  6. - Additional image 6 : IMG6
  7. - Additional image 7 : IMG7
  8. - Additional image 8 : IMG8
  9. - Additional image 9 : IMG9
  10. - Additional image 10 : IMG10
  11. - Additional image 11 : IMG11
  12. - Additional image 12 : IMG12
  13. - Auction & Gmarket additional image 1 (600*600) : IMG13
  14. - Auction & Gmarket additional image 2 (600*600) : IMG14
  15. - WeMakePrice (460*460, 500*500) : IMG15
  16. - WeMakePrice 2.0 listing image (600*400) : IMG16
  17. - W Concept main image (960*1280) : IMG17
  18. - Halfclub horizontal banner (640*320) : IMG18
  19.   GS/Ezwel mobile image
  20.   Shopping & T mobile image
5. Required image_content string Image content

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<openMarket>
	<productInfo>
		<product>
			<customer_id>a0000001</customer_id>
			<partner_product_id></partner_product_id>
			<image_type><![CDATA[URL]]></image_type>
			<image_info>
				<image>
					<image_kind><![CDATA[IMG1]]></image_kind>
					<image_content></image_content>
				</image>
				.
				.
				.
				<image>
					반복
				</image>
			</image_info>
		</product>
	</productInfo>
</openMarket>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
 Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P1524578</product_id>
		<message>등록성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
